worker_claim.report: Inspected the frozen starting HEAD 7034823dd47811e55eeefd820e70621b1756d429. Proven synchronization defect: recover acknowledges admission before dispatch, _save_state clears operator_recovery before publication, and _run_polling releases operator ownership before status_view refreshes the snapshot. Deterministic assertions reproduce old blocked plan/status both while normalization has completed with the owner active and after release before publication; fresh publication becomes run-worker only on successful recovery. The hosted failure's specific reason cannot be reconstructed from the supplied output because it was not retained. The test now uses bounded LiveService.wait_for and requires matching plan/status, exact pending execution identity, preparing projection, and running service. Startup coordination resubmits only the exact explicit busy/not-admitted response; all other rejection responses fail. No runtime or release files changed. Representative recovery/CLI/IPC validation passed 351 tests. Final repeated live run passed 12 instances with -n 4 --dist=worksteal, concurrent with full coverage validation. Full local ./dev coverage -n 4 --dist=worksteal -x --tb=short completed with 2280 passed and 2 skipped; aggregation emitted one coverage data-file warning but exited successfully and wrote coverage.json. Ruff and git diff --check passed. An earlier full coverage attempt hit the 20-minute tool timeout; the final full run completed in 21 minutes after correcting a test field-name error exposed by retained diagnostics.
